findings: Recently fallen meteorites may have a thin dark fusion crust.
Irregular shape; some shallow thumbprint depressions. Porous bubbly rocks are not the intended form.
Chondrites may have dark fusion crust and lighter gray interior.

design_decision: One fallen stony meteorite; irregular dark exterior with one small light gray fracture face; no flame, tail, sphere or vesicular holes. Identification is illustrative, not a diagnostic field test.
